## What is included

- [ ] One folder, `teams/<slug>/`, with `team.md` or `bot.md` (see FORMAT.md); `catalog.json` is not edited by hand
- [ ] It imports in MausBot
- [ ] Every member has a distinct role and clear instructions
- [ ] Every referenced skill is readable Markdown
- [ ] `npm test` passes

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, binaries, or executable scripts are included
- [ ] The team does not bypass or weaken user approvals
- [ ] Required connected apps are declared without embedding credentials
